;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Six [[Pakistani soldier]]s are killed when their vehicle was targeted by a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]]. In another attack, a soldier is shot dead by separatists. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/soldiers-killed-separate-attacks-pakistan-balochistan-200519072325405.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[2019–20 Western Libya offensive]]
***[[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Government of National Accord|GNA]] forces seize the towns of [[Badr, Libya|Badr]] and Tiji near the [[Tunisia]]n [[Libya–Tunisia border|border]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/libya-gna-recaptures-towns-tunisia-border-haftar-200519093703915.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]; [[May 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
**Gunmen storm a [[mosque]] in [[Afghanistan]]'s central [[Parwan Province]], killing seven people and wounding 12 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/gunmen-attack-afghanistan-mosque-killing-worshippers-200519192619527.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Afghan National Army|Afghan troops]] repel a [[Taliban]] attack on the northern city of [[Kunduz]], killing up to 40 [[Taliban insurgency|insurgents]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/taliban-attack-on-kunduz-repelled/article31627219.ece (''The Hindu'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*One day after former [[WWE]] wrestler [[Shad Gaspard]] disappeared near the [[Marina Del Rey]] beach in [[Venice, Los Angeles|Venice Beach]], [[California]] while swimming, the [[United States Coast Guard]] calls off the search. The [[Los Angeles Police Department]] is still searching for him. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/18/entertainment/shad-gaspard-wwe-missing-venice-beach-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*Amid heavy flooding in the [[Tittabawassee River]] caused by three straight days of heavy rainfall, the [[Edenville Dam]] in central [[Michigan]] partially collapses, prompting evacuations downstream. [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] declares a [[state of emergency]] for [[Midland County, Michigan|Midland County]] and the [[Michigan Army National Guard]] has been called in to assist. [https://www.accuweather.com/en/severe-weather/edenville-dam-breaks-sparking-immediate-evacuations-in-michigan/742939 (AccuWeather)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
****[[Annie Glenn]], widow of astronaut [[John Glenn]] and [[disability rights]] advocate, dies of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in a [[nursing home]] in [[Minnesota]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/19/us/annie-glenn-death-coronavirus-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
****[[Michigan]] becomes the fourth state in the U.S. to pass 5,000 deaths from COVID-19. The state has 5,017 reported deaths and 52,350 total cases. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/05/coronavirus-deaths-surpass-5k-in-michigan.html (MLive.com)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***The [[Ministry of Health (Brazil)|Brazilian Ministry of Health]] reports 17,408 new confirmed cases and 1,179 more deaths from COVID-19, their highest daily death toll to date, bringing [[Brazil]]'s death toll to 17,971 and 271,628 total cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil/brazil-suffers-record-coronavirus-deaths-trump-mulls-travel-ban-idUSKBN22V374 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Sudan]]
***Vice President of [[South Sudan]] [[Riek Machar]] and his wife [[Angelina Teny]] (who acts as defense minister) test positive for COVID-19 and [[Self-isolation|self-isolate]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-southsudan-machar/south-sudan-vice-president-wife-test-positive-for-coronavirus-idUSKBN22U2SI (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[2020 Trump Israel–Palestine plan|Trump peace plan]], [[Israel–Palestine relations]], [[Palestine–United States relations]]
**[[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] [[President of the State of Palestine|President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] announces the termination of all agreements, including security ones, with [[Israel]] and the [[United States]] in response to Israel's plans to [[Annexation of the Jordan Valley|annex the Jordan Valley]]. [http://english.wafa.ps/page.aspx?id=SbnBNCa117154132029aSbnBNC (WAFA)]
*[[United Kingdom–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Central Bank of Venezuela]] launches a legal claim against the [[Bank of England]], to try to force the British bank to release [[Euro|€]]930m ([[United States Dollar|$]]1bn; [[Pound sterling|£]]820m) worth of [[Venezuela]]n [[gold]] it claims it holds. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-52733299 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Toronto machete attack]]
**The [[Toronto Police Service|Toronto Police]] declares a [[machete]] attack that occurred at an [[erotic massage]] parlor in February to be an act of [[terrorism in Canada|terrorism]] driven by [[incel]] ideology. The attack left one woman dead and another injured. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6910670/toronto-spa-terrorism-incel/ (Global News)]
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**In the first [[capital punishment in the United States|execution]] since the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]] began, a [[Missouri]] man is put to death by lethal injection for [[murder (United States law)|murdering]] an elderly woman in 1991. [https://apnews.com/78ae7040d0fc20e6f3b32c371b2fa7fc (The Associated Press)]

;Politics and elections
*The [[Parliament of Lesotho]] accepts the [[resignation]] of [[Tom Thabane]]. Finance minister [[Moeketsi Majoro]] replaces him as interim [[Prime Minister of Lesotho|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-thomas-thabane-resigns-soothing-political-crisis-idUSKBN22V19E (Reuters)]
